bull.b: The definitive CHIPS Act award provides substantial nontraditional funding for cryogenic capacity, readout electronics, and advanced fabrication. This can accelerate Rigetti’s hardware roadmap, expand domestic production capabilities, and reinforce its position in U.S. quantum infrastructure over the next several years.

bull.t: Quantum hardware shows differentiated technical progress
bull.b: A 108-qubit modular system with strong measured fidelity and fast gates gives Rigetti credible technical differentiation in a developing market. Demonstrated hardware progress can support customer adoption, government work, and future system sales if performance improvements continue.

bull.t: Revenue growth and gross margin improved materially
bull.b: The sharp year-over-year revenue increase and 12-point gross-margin improvement indicate better commercial traction and a more favorable product mix, particularly from Novera systems. If repeatable, these trends can improve operating leverage and strengthen the economics of future deployments.

bear.t: Large losses and persistent cash burn
bear.b: Rigetti remains far from self-funding, with substantial operating and free-cash-flow deficits alongside very large net losses. Continued investment therefore depends on its liquidity and access to external funding, limiting financial flexibility if commercialization takes longer than expected.

Even after strong percentage growth, the absolute revenue base remains modest and dependent on individual system deliveries and funded projects. This creates uneven quarterly results and makes it difficult to absorb the company’s large cost base until recurring commercial demand becomes substantially broader.

bear.t: Scaling depends on unresolved technical and execution milestones
bear.b: Current coherence limitations constrain two-qubit performance, while the proposed improvements still require experimental validation and deployment. Failure or delay in achieving higher fidelity and scale could slow customer adoption, postpone roadmap benefits, and extend the period of heavy investment.
